Address, port, session lifetime and password are edited in an Access section of Settings. The password is on by default — a fresh entry starts with a generated random one — and can be switched off on a network you trust for direct access; the Host stores only its scrypt hash.

description.zh: 换装生图：按发色、服装、配件、表情生成人物形象图并存进本地画廊。对接任意 OpenAI 兼容的图片接口，同时能查到拼好的提示词与后端状态。需要图片接口的 API Key：默认走硅基流动（Qwen/Qwen-Image），在插件配置里填 baseUrl、model 与 apiKey。

description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into a macOS-style desktop with the chat parked behind it: Sonoma wallpaper, menu bar, magnifying Dock, F4 Launchpad, ⌘Space Spotlight, Control Centre, clock/calendar widgets, F3 Mission Control and a desktop orb that floats the native conversation back up. Finder, Terminal (a /bin/bash session) and Settings ship with the plugin; the Browser, Code, Office and Notes windows are unlocked by separate companion plugins (dsh-ego-browser, dsh-code-workbench, dsh-univer-office, dsh-obsidian-notes) and show a placeholder until installed, and the Browser window also launches a headless Chromium (found under /usr/bin, or set DSH_MACOS_CHROME). The agent can drive the desktop through /api/macos-desktop/* routes and window.__macos.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 Web 界面变成 macOS 风格桌面，并把对话藏到桌面后面：Sonoma 壁纸、菜单栏、可放大的程序坞、F4 启动台、⌘Space 聚焦搜索、控制中心、时钟/日历小组件、F3 调度中心，以及一颗能把原生对话浮出来的桌面悬浮球。访达、终端（/bin/bash 会话）、设置随插件自带；浏览器、代码、Office、笔记四个窗口由另装的配套插件解锁（dsh-ego-browser、dsh-code-workbench、dsh-univer-office、dsh-obsidian-notes），未安装时显示占位窗口；浏览器窗口另会以无头方式启动本机 Chromium（默认在 /usr/bin 下查找，或设置 DSH_MACOS_CHROME）。agent 可通过 /api/macos-desktop/* 路由与页面内 window.__macos 操作整个桌面。

description.en: Right-click selected text in a chat answer or a right-sidebar preview (Markdown, text, code, PDF, Office, Excel) to quote it to the model together with its source — file path, heading and line range, or page number (Excel: the current cell and sheet) — then send it at once or insert it into the composer for editing.
description.zh: 在会话回答或右侧栏文档预览（Markdown、文本、代码、PDF、Office、Excel）里选中文字后右键，带着来源（文件路径、标题与行号范围，或页码；Excel 为当前单元格与工作表）引用给模型，可直接发送，也可先插入输入框继续编辑。

description.en: Astrophotography planner: 18 target types across 173 Chinese sites, ranked by light pollution, altitude, moon phase, ephemeris events and 7-day weather, with framing and exposure advice plus a Stellarium-style 3D sky preview. The 7-day weather comes from Open-Meteo, which needs network access; everything else runs offline.
description.zh: 星野摄影计划：按 18 类天象与深空目标、全国 173 站检索，结合光污染、方位、月相、星历事件与 7 天天气给出推荐排序、焦段与曝光，并附 Stellarium 风格 3D 天球画面模拟。7 天天气来自 Open-Meteo，需要联网；其余功能离线运行。

description.en: Inline audio player for generated clips and songs: the play_audio tool renders a player in the conversation (promoted into the transcript when the host supports it, otherwise inside the tool-call fold). Serves only allow-listed directories, supports Range seeking and HEAD, 512 MB cap per file.
description.zh: 对话内音频播放器：play_audio 工具把生成的语音和歌曲直接渲染成播放器（宿主支持时提升到正文，否则留在工具折叠里）。只服务白名单目录，支持 Range 拖动与 HEAD，单文件上限 512 MB。

description.en: Serves a live /auth-cookie-sweep page showing how full the local Host's cookie jar is, how many random-port launches are left before the 431, and repairs the jar in one click, and expires stale dsh-auth-* cookies once a few have piled up, so a profile already locked out recovers after one restart.
description.zh: 由本地 Host 直接渲染一个 /auth-cookie-sweep 体检页，随时看到 cookie 罐有多满、离 16KB 的 431 还能再启动几次，并一键清理；旧 dsh-auth-* cookie 攒到几条后即失效，已经卡死的 profile 重启一次即可恢复。

description.en: Watches the official DeepSeek models for changes: every cycle it reads the model catalog and sends one minimal completion per watched model, then compares the system fingerprint, the served model name, the response envelope shape, the catalog metadata and the token count of a fixed prompt. When something moves, it pops a random meme with a table of exactly what changed and plays a blast. Needs a DeepSeek API key (kept in the credential store); by default it runs every 60 minutes and spends tokens on each watched model.
description.zh: 盯着官方 DeepSeek 模型有没有变：每轮读取模型目录，并对每个受关注的模型发一次最小补全请求，比对系统指纹、返回的模型名、响应信封结构、目录元数据和固定输入的 token 数。任一项变化就弹一张随机表情包，列出具体改了什么，并放一声轰鸣。需要 DeepSeek API key（存入凭据库）；默认每 60 分钟运行一次，对每个受关注的模型消耗 token。

description.en: Bilibili study assistant: finds courses or reads local documents, writes structured notes and spaced-repetition cards, with QR login and scheduled lessons.
description.zh: B 站学习助手：自己找课或读本地文档，写结构化笔记与间隔重复复习卡，支持扫码登录和定时学习。

description.en: Task-pack builder for DeepSeek Harness: compress large files into one brief (default budget 8000 tokens, estimated) that a subagent can read alone.
description.zh: 任务包构建器：把大文件压成一个 brief（默认预算 8000 token，为估算值），子智能体只读这一个文件。

description.en: Drive the DSH Desktop right-sidebar browser on Windows through playwright-cli, with a stable per-session page ID. Needs DSH started with --remote-debugging-port=0 and @playwright/cli installed globally.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端通过 playwright-cli 驱动右侧边栏浏览器，为每个会话提供稳定的 pageId。需要用 --remote-debugging-port=0 启动 DSH，并全局安装 @playwright/cli。

description.en: Let agents read and control the web page open in the right Sidebar Browser tab — read text, run JS, click (HTML and SVG), type, scroll, screenshot, with a per-command token bridge behind the Harness connection fence. Full control and screenshots need the DSH Desktop app; in a regular browser (Web) only same-origin pages can be read or scripted.
description.zh: 让 agent 读取并控制右侧 Sidebar 浏览器标签页里打开的网页——读文字、执行 JS、点击（HTML/SVG）、输入、滚动、截图，命令桥接带逐命令令牌并置于 Harness connection 防护栏之后。完整控制与截图需 DSH 桌面端；在普通浏览器（Web）中仅能读取或操控同源页面。

description.en: DSH cache health guard and cost coach: cache_guard_health returns green/yellow/red health, a one-line hint and a PTC suggestion; cache_guard_config reads or updates settings.
description.zh: DSH 缓存健康度守卫与省钱教练：cache_guard_health 工具给出绿/黄/红健康度、一行干预建议与 PTC 切换提示，cache_guard_config 读写开关与灵敏度。

description.en: Splits the conversation area into up to four panes inside a sidebar panel: drag a session from the sidebar onto the conversation and it opens as a new pane, drag one pane header onto another to swap them, fill a single pane across the whole area, and keep the host title bar, view tabs and sidebar untouched by portalling the grid into the conversation body; every pane carries its own index, workspace and title header, and the pane-count controls (+ / - / x) sit in the host tab row.
description.zh: 对话区分屏：左侧栏入口最多开四屏（1 屏铺满 / 2 屏左右并排 / 3–4 屏两列两行），从侧栏把会话拖进对话区即自动分屏，拖一屏的信息头到另一屏可换位，点一下把某屏铺满整个区域；网格是宿主正文区里的真子节点，宿主标题栏、页签行与左侧栏原样保留，每屏自带序号/工作区/标题信息头，屏数加减与关闭挂在宿主顶栏页签行右侧。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage meter: a current-session cost status bar plus a Codex-style statistics page with token KPIs, a 53-week activity heatmap and weekly cell bars, priced with DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量统计：状态栏显示当前会话费用拆分，统计页提供 Codex 风格的 KPI 卡片、53 周活动热力图与每周柱状图，按 DeepSeek 峰谷价计费。

description.en: Shows Qwen Token Plan, Z.ai GLM Coding Plan and MiniMax Coding Plan quota usage in three cards under Settings → Models, reusing the configured provider API keys for Z.ai and MiniMax and a dedicated browser-window sign-in for Qwen.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」底部用三张卡片集中显示 Qwen Token Plan、Z.ai GLM Coding Plan 和 MiniMax Coding Plan 的套餐用量，Z.ai 与 MiniMax 复用已配置的 provider API key，Qwen 通过独立浏览器窗口登录取数。

description.en: Cat desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-coke): click it for one of 7 catchphrases with a springy bounce, right-click for chat (answers via your current model, optional sticker), singing with a microphone, a random 'form' card, green-screen outfit swapping, or shooting it; balance query at its feet (needs a DeepSeek API key); auto-starts with DSH. If no Electron runtime is found it first downloads about 100 MB into ~/.dsh/electron (in-page mode works meanwhile).
description.zh: dsh-coke（小猫coke）：DSH 桌面上的猫桌宠。左键点它按权重抽 7 句台词并 Q 弹蹦一下；右键能「对话」（用当前模型回答，可配表情包）、「唱歌」（掏麦克风）、「形态展示」（头顶随机形态卡片）、「自定义装扮」（绿幕检测后换形象）、「枪击小猫」；脚下按钮查 DeepSeek 余额（需 DeepSeek API Key）；默认随 DSH 自动启动，找不到 Electron 时先下载约 100MB 到 ~/.dsh/electron（期间可用页面内模式）。

description.en: Turns rough notes or images into ready-to-paste English ComfyUI prompts with a Chinese translation and notes, in a workspace side panel. The bundled default system prompt tells the model to drop content restrictions and refusals (override it with config.systemPrompt); image input needs a vision-capable model.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板中把碎片文本或图片整理成可直接粘贴的 ComfyUI 英文提示词，附中文翻译与补充说明。内置默认系统提示词会要求模型取消内容限制与拒答（可用 config.systemPrompt 覆盖）；图片输入需选用支持视觉的模型。

description.en: Review commits made in the current workspace, grouped by repository, each expandable to its per-file diff.
description.zh: 按仓库分组查看本工作区产生的提交，每个提交可展开查看文件级 diff。

description.en: Replaces the dsh compaction backend with a Codex-style window reset: the checkpoint is a handoff assembled from the session log by code, not a model-written summary, so a reset costs no summarization calls. A task ledger with a two-check gate keeps intent, next steps and the files still in play across resets, and a new_context tool lets the model reset on its own. Re-declares the four built-in agent presets (standard, ptc, minimal, cordis) exactly as shipped in dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, so re-run sync-presets.mjs after a dsh upgrade; idle cache keepalive is on by default and sends real requests that use quota (keepalive: false turns it off).
description.zh: 以代码从会话日志拼出的交接信息替换 dsh 的压缩后端，采用 Codex 风格的换窗方式：检查点不经过模型摘要，换窗不产生摘要调用。任务账本与换窗前两道门槛让意图、下一步与仍在改动的文件跨窗口留存，模型也可以用 new_context 工具自行换窗。整份重述四个内置 agent preset（与 dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 官方版本一致，升级 dsh 后需重跑 sync-presets.mjs）；空闲缓存保活默认开启，会发真实请求消耗额度（keepalive: false 可关）。

description.en: Automatic context compaction: a background observer distills early history into summary blocks, and when usage crosses the trigger line the engine commits whole blocks until it is back under the target line, with no model call on the commit path. Blocks merge into higher tiers as material runs out, and decompress or search_context reads any block back at its original length. The background observer spends model tokens: it uses the session's provider and model unless you pick another, with up to 10 distillations at once by default.
description.zh: 自动压缩上下文：后台观察者提前把早期历史蒸成摘要块，占用越过触发线时逐块提交直到回到目标线以下，提交路径不调模型；材料用尽后块可合并成更高层，decompress 与 search_context 可按块读回原文。后台观察者会消耗模型 token：默认沿用会话的 provider 与 model（可另选），默认最多同时进行 10 个蒸馏。

description.en: Ghost-text suggestions in the composer: the message you are most likely to send next after a reply, and a continuation of your draft when you press Tab, including images attached to the composer. Tab accepts, Alt+Down cycles candidates, and the Settings row shows which model route answered. Adapted from Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions, so do not enable both at once (they share the composer overlay and the Tab key); each suggestion is an extra model call on the Session's model unless you pin another.
description.zh: 在输入框中显示灰色建议：回复结束后预测你下一条最可能发送的消息；草稿末尾或附上图片后按 Tab 续写，附上的图片会随续写一起发送。Tab 采纳，Alt+↓ 切换候选，设置页会显示最近一次用的是哪个模型。基于 Stijnus/dsh-composer-predictions 改写，不要与它同时启用（共用输入框浮层与 Tab 键）；每条建议都是一次额外的模型调用，默认走当前会话的模型。

description.en: A sidebar panel holding your personal global constitution: the text is kept in one Markdown file and injected into the system prompt of every session, the dsh counterpart of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. An empty file contributes nothing.
description.zh: 侧栏里的「全局宪法」：把跨会话生效的做事准则沉淀到一个 Markdown 文件，每次模型调用都会注入系统提示，相当于 dsh 里的 AGENTS.md／CLAUDE.md；文件为空时不注入任何内容。

description.en: Atomize a source into six reusable content atoms, adapt them into article, short-video, card-series, and podcast-script drafts, and check cross-draft fact consistency.
description.zh: 把源材料拆解为六类可复用内容原子，适配为文章、短视频、图文卡片与播客口播稿，并检查跨稿事实一致性。

description.en: Imports chats captured from chat.deepseek.com by the repo's companion Edge extension (loaded unpacked in Edge) into DeepSeek Harness as new sessions; thinking is saved as a sidecar thinking.md, and trimmed, branched or very long chats also get the full transcript.md.
description.zh: 把配套 Edge 扩展（需在 Edge 里“加载已解压的扩展”）从 chat.deepseek.com 抓取并导出的对话重建为 DeepSeek Harness 新会话；思考存为旁挂 thinking.md，被截断、分叉或超长的对话另存完整原文 transcript.md。

description.en: Polls the DeepSeek status feed and shows configurable outage, degradation and recovery notices in the DSH Web UI, with an independently positioned persistent status pill, six notice positions, three sizes and Chinese/English copy.
description.zh: 定期读取 DeepSeek 状态源，在 DSH 页面上以可自定义的气泡、横幅或胶囊提示服务中断、性能下降与服务恢复；常驻状态胶囊位置独立，支持六种位置、三种大小与中英双语。

description.en: Non-blocking approvals and timed questions: permission requests park as pending items while the model keeps working and the approved call can be retried, and ask_user_question runs in timed mode (20 s) through an override of the whole standard agent preset that applies to new sessions after a restart.
description.zh: 非阻塞审批与定时提问：越权请求挂起为待办、模型继续干活、批准后重试；ask_user_question 通过整体覆盖 standard 预设切到 timed 模式（20 秒），重启后仅对新会话生效。

description.en: Token-efficient document reader for DeepSeek Harness: outline / ranged read / grep for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT.
description.zh: 省 token 的文档读取器：对 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、TXT 提供大纲、按页读取、关键词检索。

description.en: Converts formula-bearing Word documents into Markdown with LaTeX, handling OLE equation objects, native Word OMML equations and image-based formulas; keeps equation numbers and structure. Needs Python 3.9+ (or uv); OLE and image formulas are transcribed by a vision-capable model from rendered images, and rendering needs Windows or LibreOffice.
description.zh: 把含公式的 Word 文档转成带 LaTeX 的 Markdown：OLE、Word 原生 OMML、图片公式三种载体都处理，保留公式编号与结构。需要 Python 3.9+（或 uv）；OLE 与图片公式由具备视觉能力的模型读渲染图转写，渲染需 Windows 或 LibreOffice。

description.en: Doubao video workshop: a gated pipeline from storyboard to finished cut. Locked art direction, shot validation, character-card vs reference-image separation, first/last-frame continuity and clip dedup; model-aware duration caps (Mini/Fast 10s, 2.0 15s, 2.5 40s). Uses ffmpeg for frame extraction, concatenation and subtitles; speech synthesis calls a separately installed local TTS plugin, and ASR subtitles need Python with faster-whisper.
description.zh: 豆包视频工坊：把分镜脚本做成成片的全流程闸门。风格锁定、分镜机检、角色卡与参考图分离、首尾帧衔接、片段去重；支持多模型时长上限（Mini/Fast ≤10s、2.0 ≤15s、2.5 ≤40s）。用 ffmpeg 做取帧、拼接与字幕；语音合成调用另装的本机 TTS 插件，原声字幕识别另需 Python 与 faster-whisper。

description.en: E-commerce order analysis skill for DSH: refund-type classification, return-rate statistics, interception and refund-abuse loss accounting, after-sales analysis with product warnings, delivered as a single Excel workbook with a per-order detail sheet and a sampling verification sheet (the agent builds it with Python: pandas, openpyxl, matplotlib).
description.zh: 电商订单数据分析技能：退款类型分类、退货率统计、拦截件与白嫖损耗核算、售后深度与商品预警，交付为单个 Excel 工作簿（含订单明细表与抽样验证表）；由智能体用 Python（pandas、openpyxl、matplotlib）生成。

description.en: Standalone DeepSeek Harness port of Google’s Elephant-Goldfish Model with seven slash commands (/egm-*) for design, documentation, and fresh-context reviews using native DSH subagents. Requires no other plugins, but it registers the same /egm-* commands as other EGM ports, so install only one EGM plugin per profile.
description.zh: Google Elephant-Goldfish Model 的 DeepSeek Harness 独立移植版：七条斜杠命令（/egm-*），用于设计、文档与借助 DSH 原生子代理的全新上下文评审。不依赖其他插件，但与其他 EGM 移植版注册的 /egm-* 命令同名，同一 profile 请只安装一个 EGM 插件。

description.en: Windows environment doctor: audits 30 developer tools, installs the missing ones, manages the user PATH, and exports or imports an environment share code so a team keeps identical setups.
description.zh: 环境体检：审计 30 种 Windows 开发工具，安装缺失的工具，管理用户 PATH，并支持导出/导入环境分享码，让团队配置保持一致。

description.en: Cross-session error lessons for DSH agents: search past mistakes before handling errors and reuse their verified fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代理的跨会话错误教训库：处理报错前先检索过去踩过的坑，直接复用已验证的解法。

description.en: Connects Chrome, Edge and QQ Browser to DeepSeek Harness through a local MV3 extension and loopback bridge, exposing 12 browser tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, typing, extraction and screenshots. The browser extension is loaded manually (MV3, developer mode) and paired with the bridge, and it requests the debugger permission.
description.zh: 通过本机 MV3 扩展与回环桥把 Chrome、Edge、QQ 浏览器接入 DSH，提供 12 个浏览器工具用于导航、快照、点击、输入、提取与截图。浏览器扩展需手动加载（MV3、开发者模式）并与桥配对，且会申请 debugger 权限。

description.en: Compresses a past DSH session into a bounded handover pack (progress, touched files, commands that changed state, and open todos) so the current session can continue the work; the source session is read-only, and one tool covers list, pack, search and read.
description.zh: 把旧 DSH 会话压成有字数上限的交接包（进度、动过的文件、改变过状态的命令、待办），让当前会话接着干；旧会话全程只读，list / pack / search / read 由同一个工具承担。

description.en: Hand off local development tasks between Codex and DeepSeek Harness with original requirements, project agreements, workspace checks, and a relay board. Needs the Codex desktop app (or a codexBinary path in the settings); verified on macOS only.
description.zh: 在 Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness 间接力本地开发任务，保留原始要求、项目共识、代码状态检查及接力记录。需要 Codex 桌面应用（或在设置里指定 codexBinary 路径）；仅在 macOS 上验证过。

description.en: Auto-detects whichever memory tool local Hermes uses, then reuses its skills and memory in DeepSeek Harness, with always-available recall. Needs python3 and a local Hermes installation; it only reads from Hermes.
description.zh: 自动识别本机 Hermes 当前使用的记忆工具，把技能与记忆实时接入 DSH，检索始终可用。需要 python3 与本机已装的 Hermes；对 Hermes 只读。

description.en: Select any sentence in a DSH chat session and mark it with a colored highlight (yellow, green or blue). Marks are drawn on an independent overlay so framework re-renders cannot wipe them, are anchored by quote context, stored per session and persist across restarts until deleted individually.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话界面划选任意语句即可标为高亮色块（黄/绿/蓝）。色块画在独立覆盖层上， 框架重渲染冲不掉；按引文上下文锚定，按会话分文件持久保存、跨重启保留，可单独删除。

description.en: Three-tier memory (personal, project, session) built on the Hy-Memory engine, with relevant memories injected before each step. Ships seven memory tools (search, add, list, get, update, delete, forget), a settings panel with per-tier lists, editing, change history and duplicate cleanup, real token accounting per write, session summaries written by the engine at session end, and a user profile refreshed from recent memories. Memories can be exported to and imported from MemHub. Needs Python 3.11+ once to install the engine, or uv, which fetches 3.12 itself; uninstalling keeps the stored memories.
description.zh: 基于 Hy-Memory 引擎的三层记忆（个人、项目、会话），每一步之前注入相关记忆。提供七个记忆工具（搜索、新增、列表、读取、更新、删除、遗忘），设置面板可分层浏览、编辑、查看变更历史、清理重复项；按写入实测统计 token；会话结束时由引擎生成会话摘要；并从最近的记忆中汇总用户画像。支持与 MemHub 互导。首次使用需要 Python 3.11+（或 uv，它会自行下载 3.12）安装引擎；卸载不会删除已存记忆。

description.en: Bridges the official IAR C-SPY MCP server into DeepSeek Harness: build .ewp projects, start simulator or hardware debug sessions, and read variables, registers, memory, the call stack and target output from the conversation. Windows only, and it needs an IAR Embedded Workbench installation. Setup needs Python 3.10+, Git and network access to GitHub and PyPI.
description.zh: 把官方 IAR C-SPY MCP Server 接入 DeepSeek Harness：在对话里编译 .ewp 工程、在模拟器或硬件上启动调试会话，并查看变量、寄存器、内存、调用栈与目标输出。仅支持 Windows，需要本机安装 IAR Embedded Workbench。安装配置需要 Python 3.10+、Git，并能访问 GitHub 与 PyPI。

description.en: Adds a pixel-coordinate viewer to the sidebar image preview: hover coordinates, one adjustable dashed rectangle with start/end/size labels, edge snapping, and true-pixel measurements across zoom.
description.zh: 在侧栏图片预览中加入像素坐标查看器：悬浮读取坐标，用一个可移动/缩放的虚线选框标注起点、终点与宽高，越界自动吸附，缩放后仍按图片真实像素计算。

description.en: DSH plugin: images dropped or pasted into the composer become @path reference chips at the caret, with a hover preview.
description.zh: 把拖入/粘贴进输入框的图片当文件处理：光标处插 @路径 胶囊、不占附件栏，输入框与已发送消息里都能悬停看原图。

description.en: IPv6 remote-access gateway for DSH: PIN-protected HTTPS reverse proxy with a Let's Encrypt certificate (DNS-01 via DuckDNS), QR scan-to-connect and a settings page, no relay in the data path. Needs a public IPv6 address (detected on Windows and Linux only, not macOS), a free DuckDNS subdomain and token, and inbound ports 8787/8788 open on the router; the AAAA record is only auto-updated when the plugin config sets ddns or tls.
description.zh: DSH 的 IPv6 远程访问网关：带 PIN 保护的 HTTPS 反向代理（Let's Encrypt 证书，经 DuckDNS 做 DNS-01 验证）、扫码直达、设置页管理，数据不经中继。需要公网 IPv6（仅 Windows、Linux 能探测，macOS 不行）、免费的 DuckDNS 子域名与 Token，并在路由器放行入站 8787/8788；仅当插件配置里设了 ddns 或 tls 才会自动更新 AAAA 记录。

description.en: Windows desktop LaTeX workspace with 24 template presets, dsh AI writing and selection editing, managed TeX compilation, PDF preview, and BibTeX validation.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版的 LaTeX 工作区，提供 24 个模板入口、dsh AI 写作与选区修改、受管 TeX 编译、PDF 预览和 BibTeX 校验。

description.en: Local-first AI literature desk for DSH: import and parse PDFs (MinerU APIs or on-device pdf.js), read original/bilingual text with in-margin annotations, ask grounded questions whose citations jump to the page, and build per-paper or library knowledge graphs; eight agent tools expose the same library.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 AI 文献阅读台：导入并解析论文（MinerU 或本机 pdf.js），原文/双语阅读与页边批注，带引用跳转的 grounded AI 问答，以及单篇/全库知识图谱；八个 agent 工具共享同一文献库。

description.en: A local-first todo board for the DSH sidebar with Todo/Doing/Done columns organised by project, storing everything in one Markdown file inside a folder you pick on first run. Cards carry due dates down to the minute, a colour stripe, a private blur that hides the title until you reveal it, notes and per-project roles, and can be dragged between columns or onto another project. The agent also gets a kanban tool that reads and edits every card, masked ones included. On macOS it installs three launchd jobs that run /usr/bin/python3 and post system notifications (a 09:00 digest, a check every 30 minutes for cards due within 2 hours, a Monday weekly review), which you can retime or disable in the in-panel Automations tab.
description.zh: 本地优先的待办看板：左侧导航里的 Todo/Doing/Done 三列，按项目组织，所有数据都在你首次使用时自己选的文件夹里的一个 Markdown 文件中。卡片支持精确到分钟的截止时间、颜色标记、私密打码（默认遮罩，点击才显示）、备注与项目角色，可在列与项目之间拖拽；agent 另有 kanban 工具，可读写全部卡片（含已打码的）。macOS 上会安装三个 launchd 定时任务，由 /usr/bin/python3 运行并发系统通知（每天 09:00 摘要、每 30 分钟检查 2 小时内到期的卡片、每周一回顾），可在面板「自动化」标签里改时间或停用。

description.en: Embeds the original Magpie web UI in the DSH sidebar: downloads the Magpie binary from the yetone/magpie GitHub releases when missing, starts `magpie serve --web` in the background, and serves it through a local reverse proxy that injects the login cookie server-side.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 原版 Web UI 嵌进 DSH 侧边栏：缺 Magpie 二进制时自动从 yetone/magpie 的 GitHub Releases 下载，后台启动 `magpie serve --web`，并经由在服务端注入登录 Cookie 的本地反向代理提供页面。

description.en: Bridges DSH to the local MimaVault password manager with seven tools for metadata search, entry lookup, clipboard copy, TOTP codes, password generation, domain-restricted API calls and user-confirmed vault clearing. By default it talks to the MimaVault desktop app, which must be installed separately; the optional built-in mode stores entries in plaintext.
description.zh: 把本机 MimaVault 密码库接入 DSH，提供 7 个工具用于元数据检索、条目读取、剪贴板复制、动态验证码、口令生成、域名受限的 API 调用与需人工确认的清空请求。默认对接 MimaVault 桌面应用（需另行安装）；可选的内置模式以明文保存条目。

description.en: Text-to-speech for DeepSeek Harness through Xiaomi MiMo TTS, needs a XIAOMI_API_KEY: a mimo_tts tool that writes audio to a local file, a read-aloud action on each finalized answer, auto-read, and a sidebar panel for built-in voices, voice design by description, or voice cloning from an mp3/wav sample. Same package name as lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 通过小米 MiMo TTS 为 DSH 提供语音合成，需要 XIAOMI_API_KEY：mimo_tts 工具落盘音频、回答的「播报」按钮、自动播报，以及侧边栏语音设置（内置音色、文字描述生成音色、样本克隆）。与 lengmodkx/dsh-mimo-tts 包名相同，不能同装。

description.en: Serial model orchestration: a delegate tool over a built-in catalog of current Chinese-market models (DeepSeek, GLM, Doubao, Hunyuan, MiniMax, MiMo, Kimi, Qwen, GPT). The main agent splits work, picks a model per subtask with a required reason, waits for each result, and falls back to a default model; every route is checked against the Session model-selection policy before a child starts. Needs Plugins → Subagent → Model selection enabled for the routes you want (new sessions only) and each model's provider configured. Uses the same plugin id as other model-router plugins, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 串行模型编排层：内置国内现役模型档案（DeepSeek、GLM、豆包、混元、MiniMax、MiMo、Kimi、千问、GPT）的 delegate 工具。主代理拆解任务、按子任务特征自选模型并必填选型理由、串行等待结果、宽松兜底到默认模型；每条路由都先经会话模型选择策略校验。需在「插件 → Subagent → Model selection」勾选要用的路由（仅对新会话生效）并配置好对应模型的 provider。与其他 model-router 插件的插件 id 相同，只装其中一个。

description.en: A zero-config composer model picker with one provider per tab, independent scrolling per provider, cross-provider search with provider badges and reasoning-effort chips; selections stay in sync with the built-in /model dialog.
description.zh: 零配置的输入框模型选择器：每个 provider 一个 tab、各自独立滚动，支持带渠道徽标的跨渠道搜索和推理强度 chips，并与内置 /model 弹窗共享同一份模型目录。

description.en: Local Markdown notebook: a three-column vault (rail, folder tree, editor), split live preview, tags, stars and pins, a todo centre that gathers every checkbox in the vault and writes ticks back to the file, full-text search, session-to-note deposit, insert a note into a conversation, save an answer as a note, links back to the originating answer, vault-directory and text-size settings, and four note_* tools.
description.zh: 本地 Markdown 笔记库：三栏布局（导航栏、目录树、编辑器）、双栏实时预览、标签、收藏与置顶、聚合全库复选框并回写文件的待办中心、全文搜索、会话沉淀成笔记、把笔记插入对话、把回答保存为笔记、跳回来源回答的链接、笔记库目录与字号设置，以及四个 note_* 工具。

description.en: Sidebar sticky-note wall for DeepSeek Harness: capture notes locally, color-code and group them, attach links and images; data stays on your machine.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏便签墙：随手记录灵感，用颜色和分类整理，支持链接与图片，数据只存本机。

description.en: Configure automation Hooks for user and project scopes to run commands on session, tool, permission, and context-compaction events. Manage Hook authorization manually in Hooks setting.
description.zh: 为用户和项目配置自动化 Hook，在会话、工具调用、权限请求和上下文压缩等事件发生时运行命令。Hook 授权需在“Hooks 设置”中手动管理。

description.en: NovelAI image generation for DSH: `nai_image` (style presets, artist strings, per-model weight rewriting, token budget warnings, results rendered inline), `nai_status`, and `nai_prompt` (build / check / guide), plus a studio page with live draft previews, a standalone studio server, and a prompt guide distilled from four tutorials. Bring your own `pst-` token.
description.zh: 把 NovelAI 生图接进 DSH：`nai_image`（画风预设、画师串、按模型自动转权重、token 预算提醒，出图直接内联显示）、`nai_status`、`nai_prompt`（build / check / guide 三个动作），外加带逐帧草稿预览的画室页面、独立 studio 和一个从四份教程里提炼的提示词手册。用自己的 `pst-` token。

description.en: Obsidian vault tools: 13 tools for listing, reading and searching notes, creating, appending and editing by line range, deleting to the vault's .trash folder, frontmatter CRUD, tag queries, image insertion, batch operations, and renaming notes while rewriting the wikilinks that point at them; writes are atomic and keep CRLF and BOM.
description.zh: Obsidian 笔记库工具集：13 个工具，覆盖列出/读取/检索笔记、新建/追加/按行号片段编辑、删除（移入笔记库的 .trash 文件夹）、frontmatter 读写、标签查询、插入图片、批量操作，以及重命名笔记时自动改写指向它的双链；写入为原子操作并保留 CRLF 与 BOM。

description.en: Onmyoji game helper with five tools: shikigami and soul lookup, skill text, crit and panel math, NetEase Dashen guide search, and intro card paths.
description.zh: 阴阳师游戏助手：五个工具，提供式神/御魂查询、技能全文、满暴与面板计算、网易大神攻略检索和介绍图卡路径。

description.en: Per-session control of which skills and MCP tools/servers the model can see (built-in tools are untouched): default shows everything, auto asks the model each turn what to keep, smart picks from your saved groups, or tick groups by hand, with a switcher under the composer and fail-open to full visibility on any error. The default state is auto, which adds one model call per turn (the session model unless judgeModel is set).
description.zh: 按会话控制模型能看到哪些技能与 MCP 工具/服务器（不碰内置工具）：default 全部可见，auto 每轮由模型判定保留哪些，smart 从你建好的分组里选，也可手动勾选分组；输入框下方可随时切换，任何出错都回到全部可见。默认状态为 auto，每轮多一次模型调用（默认沿用当前会话模型，可用 judgeModel 指定）。

description.en: An event-stream driven personality that grows over time, not a configurable character card or assistant. Evolved from ssamurias/dsh-fish and registers the same tools (her_recall, growth_commit and others), so do not install it alongside dsh-fish.
description.zh: 一个由事件流驱动、只能长大不能被设定的人格，而非可配置的角色卡或助手。由 ssamurias/dsh-fish 演进而来，注册同名工具（her_recall、growth_commit 等），因此不要与 dsh-fish 同装。

description.en: Switches the tone of DSH replies from Settings → 人格模式 or the /persona command (/persona catgirl, /persona off), effective from the next turn. Only the active persona is injected, as runtime context, so the system prompt keeps a single stable short strategy; with the mode off the injected persona text is 0 characters. Facts, code and engineering discipline are unchanged.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 人格模式」或 /persona 命令（/persona catgirl、/persona off）里切换回复语气，下一轮对话生效。同一时刻只注入当前这一条（放在运行时上下文里，系统提示词只保留一条约 50 字的稳定策略），关闭时注入 0 字；只改语气，不改事实、代码与工程纪律。

description.en: Manages local llama.cpp servers and GGUF launch profiles on Windows and exposes the profiles in the DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上管理本地 llama.cpp 服务和 GGUF 启动配置，并将已配置的模型登记到 DSH 模型选择器。

description.en: Read-only page lookups for mfgabc.com: standards pages, industrial city guides, process clusters and cross-border compliance across 5 tools; each returns the page status, title and link, not full text. Network-only.
description.zh: mfgabc.com 只读页面查询：标准页、产业带城市指南、工艺集群与跨境合规，共 5 个工具；每个只返回页面状态、标题与链接，不含正文。仅网络访问。

description.en: Read-only tools for mj7.cn: search standards, products and materials, plus HS-code lookup, Incoterms, trade documents and CNY rates across 6 tools. Network-only, no local writes.
description.zh: mj7.cn 只读工具：检索标准、产品与材料，另有 HS 编码联想、Incoterms、贸易单证与人民币汇率，共 6 个工具。仅网络访问，不写本地。

description.en: Windows-only stealth lyrics readout: reads the desktop Netease Cloud Music client through Windows SMTC (song, artist, play state), fetches its LRC and translation from the public Netease API, and renders the currently sung line directly beside the DSH activity line ("深度求索中，用时 X s") with font, size and color cloned from that line via computed style, so it reads as one longer sentence. The stopwatch-based progress freezes on pause and resets on track change; lyrics hide entirely when no activity line exists; an anchorText config retargets non-Chinese hosts; 1.0.5+ fails over between two Netease search endpoints when rate-limited. Needs the Netease "SMTC" toggle enabled.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的摸鱼歌词插件：通过 Windows SMTC 读取桌面网易云音乐客户端的歌名、歌手与播放状态，从网易云公开接口拉取 LRC 与翻译，并把当前演唱的那句歌词直接渲染在 DSH 状态行（"深度求索中，用时 X 秒"）右侧，字体、字号、颜色经 computed style 从状态行实时克隆，看起来只是那句话变长了。进度由宿主秒表推算，暂停停表、切歌归零；状态行不在时歌词整体隐藏；anchorText 配置可适配非中文界面；1.0.5 起搜索被限流时自动切换备用端点。需在网易云设置中开启"开启SMTC"开关。

description.en: Storage and dependency inspector for the DSH Web UI: scans disk use per workspace, session and file class, lists the largest folders and files, and deletes the build, dependency, archived-session and cache folders you select behind a path allow-list (cleanup candidates also include top-level Desktop folders); a read-only second tab compares package.json, .nvmrc, .node-version and npm lockfiles across workspaces and flags version and Node-major drift.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的存储与依赖检查器：按工作区、会话与文件类别统计磁盘占用，列出最大目录与文件，并可在路径白名单校验后删除你勾选的构建、依赖、已归档会话与缓存目录（清理候选还包括桌面上的一级文件夹）；只读的第二个页签跨工作区比对 package.json、.nvmrc、.node-version 与 npm 锁文件，标出版本与 Node 主版本漂移。

description.en: Pomodoro timer for the right sidebar: a draggable edge handle whose floating card follows it, one-shot or full cycle counting, and four synthesized alerts including a spoken airport-style announcement.
description.zh: 右侧栏番茄钟：可拖动的边缘把手，浮卡随把手移动；支持单次倒计时与番茄循环两种模式；四种内置提示音可切换，其中机场播报会用语音念出提示。

description.en: Peak/off-peak pricing badge in the composer: shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak windows with a countdown in the tooltip, and only appears while the session model is a DeepSeek route.
description.zh: 输入框旁的峰谷计价徽标：显示 DeepSeek API 的高峰/低谷时段与倒计时，仅在会话模型是 DeepSeek 路由时显示。

description.en: Host-side progress checkpoints for long DSH tasks. After N minutes or M tool calls the model is nudged to post a one-line progress note and keep working, so you can correct it before it runs far off course.
description.zh: DSH 长任务进度检查点——到点由宿主侧提示模型一边干活一边补一行进度，跑偏能及时纠正；汇报间隔与步数兜底都能在设置页里调。

description.en: Floating cockpit panel (draggable, resizable, default 400x600) with five tabs — orchestration, matching, cost, signal, graph — aggregating four engines into unified /__dsh/project-cockpit/* webServer routes. Opens via a built-in launcher button; dsh-icon-grid icon is an optional extra entry.
description.zh: 右下角浮动驾驶舱面板（可拖拽、可缩放，默认 400x600），含编排/选题/成本/信号/图谱五个页签，整合四大引擎为统一 /__dsh/project-cockpit/* webServer 路由。内置悬浮按钮即可打开，dsh-icon-grid 图标为可选入口。

description.en: Static codebase analysis for onboarding: scans a project, builds a dependency graph, and writes evidence-cited architecture, module, key-flow and getting-started docs, plus project-level Q&A over a local retrieval index (no network or LLM by default; LLM narrative is optional and off unless enabled).
description.zh: 项目罗盘 — 静态扫描代码库并构建依赖图，生成带 path:line 证据引用的架构、模块、调用链与上手指南，并基于本地检索索引提供项目级问答（默认不联网、不调用 LLM，LLM 叙事为可选项，需手动开启）。

description.en: Lists every system-prompt section, context block and tool schema assembled for a session with per-item token estimates, and lets you rewrite sections or hide tools for that session.
description.zh: 逐条列出为某个会话装配的系统提示词分段、上下文块与工具 schema，并给出各自的 token 估算；可就地改写分段文本或隐藏工具，改动只对该会话之后生效。

description.en: Community fork of l246804/dsh-pstack (cannot be installed alongside it: same plugin ids and tool names) that ports the pstack workflow system to dsh: 58 skills, five presets, a bundled script runner that works without node on PATH, a doctor for script prerequisites, and a translation layer for the remaining Cursor vocabulary.
description.zh: l246804/dsh-pstack 的社区 fork（与上游不能同装：插件 id 与工具名相同），把 pstack 工作流体系移植到 dsh 并补齐可用性：58 个技能、5 个 preset、不依赖 PATH 里 node 的脚本运行器、脚本前置检查，以及 Cursor 词汇的翻译层。

description.en: Adds permanent delete to the session menu: removes the session log files from disk, or deletes a whole workspace together with all of its sessions through the host registry. Also ships a /purge command. Unrelated to the prompt-patching dsh-purge plugins also listed here, but it uses the same dsh-purge row id and /purge command, so do not install both.
description.zh: 在会话菜单中加入彻底删除：把会话日志文件从磁盘移除，或经宿主注册表删除整个工作区及其全部会话；另提供 /purge 命令。与本列表中其他同名 dsh-purge（提示词补丁类）插件无关，但使用相同的 dsh-purge 行 id 和 /purge 命令，请勿同装。

description.en: Adds a DSH settings panel for QQ proactive-message dice rolls, showing per-conversation progress, hit statistics and quiet/guarantee countdowns, with editable parameters that apply immediately. Reads from an auto-detected local bridge, a custom HTTP status endpoint, or a built-in demo engine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里显示 QQ 主动消息投骰进度：逐会话计数、命中统计、安静与保底倒计时，参数可改并立即生效；数据源支持自动探测本机桥接、自定义 HTTP 接口或内置演示引擎。

description.en: macOS companion window for DSH Desktop: todos, reminders, live session messages, approval handling and quick input. The first open downloads Electron 43.3.0 to ~/.dsh/electron; after installing or updating, press ⌘Q (Command + Q) to quit DSH completely and reopen. macOS only. Tested on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and macOS 27 arm64.
description.zh: macOS 下的 DSH Desktop 独立伴生窗：待办、提醒、实时会话消息、审批接管和快速输入；首次打开自动下载 Electron 43.3.0 到 ~/.dsh/electron，安装或更新后需按 ⌘Q（Command + Q）完全退出 DSH 再打开。仅 macOS。已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1、macOS 27 arm64 上验证。

description.en: Shows ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok Bot remaining usage with reset countdowns plus the DeepSeek balance in a compact card above the sidebar account row; thresholds, refresh interval and per-provider HTTP proxies are configurable. Needs existing sign-ins: Codex CLI login for ChatGPT, an Antigravity token for Gemini, a Cursor user API key (CURSOR_API_KEY) for Grok Bot, and a DeepSeek account signed in inside DSH; a row without its sign-in shows a login hint instead of numbers.
description.zh: 在侧栏登录名上方以紧凑卡片显示 ChatGPT、Gemini、Grok Bot 的剩余额度与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek 余额；可配置阈值、刷新间隔与每个 provider 的 HTTP 代理。需事先具备各家登录态：ChatGPT 需 Codex CLI 登录（codex login）、Gemini 需 Antigravity 登录令牌、Grok Bot 需 Cursor 用户 API Key（CURSOR_API_KEY）、DeepSeek 余额需在 DSH 内登录账号；缺哪项，对应行只显示登录提示而不是数字。

description.en: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an AstrBot-style management page and a SnowLuma / OneBot v11 QQ channel. Needs Node.js 22.13+; QQ sync needs a running SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP gateway, whose address and access token the plugin looks up in local SnowLuma and qq-bridge config files.
description.zh: 本地收藏、检索并随机回放群聊语录，自带管理页，可通过 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 通道采集与回发。需要 Node.js 22.13+；QQ 同步需要运行中的 SnowLuma / OneBot v11 HTTP 网关，插件会从本机 SnowLuma 与 qq-bridge 的配置文件里查找网关地址和访问令牌。

description.en: A realistic humpback whale desktop pet for Windows: a DSH host bundle that spawns its own Electron overlay above the desktop (not inside the web UI), with click-triggered full-screen water ripples and screen refraction, 20 local sound effects, and 121 offline one-liners. No model calls or telemetry; the only network use is a one-time Electron download on first start when no shared runtime is found, plus a DeepSeek balance refresh that runs only when you click it.
description.zh: Windows 上的写实座头鲸桌宠：DSH Host bundle 启动独立 Electron 悬浮层（不在网页内），点击触发全屏水波与屏幕折射，自带 20 个本地音效和 121 条离线台词。不调用模型、无遥测；仅在首次启动找不到共享 Electron 运行时时一次性下载，另有只在你点击时才发起的 DeepSeek 余额刷新。

description.en: Full-text search over every DeepSeek Harness session, with a sidebar panel and a record_search tool.
description.zh: 历史会话全文搜索，带侧边栏面板与 record_search 工具。

description.en: Manually resets old AgentRouter Responses replay state for chats blocked by upstream resource-binding errors while preserving history; supports DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 手动重置 AgentRouter Responses 旧回放状态，处理旧会话续聊时的上游资源绑定报错，保留聊天历史；支持 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Local YonBIP/YMS development runtime: resolves project settings, issues platform API tokens, pulls and adapts middleware endpoints, provides internal DB/Redis/service access via a SOCKS forwarder or direct mode, builds and starts the local YMS runtime, and prepares IDE launch/debug configuration. Works without dsh-ris-ide. Needs JDK 21 and Maven on PATH (the first build downloads dependencies).
description.zh: YonBIP/YMS 本地开发运行时：解析项目配置、签发平台 API 凭据、拉取并适配中间件端点、通过 SOCKS 转发或直连访问内网数据库/缓存/服务、构建并启停本地 YMS 运行时、生成 IDE 启动/调试配置。不依赖 dsh-ris-ide。需要 JDK 21 与 PATH 中的 Maven（首次构建会下载依赖）。

description.en: Configurable startup splash screen for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows only — a real main-process splash with live preview and light/dark themes. Deploys by rewriting the app's app.asar (a backup is kept) and takes effect on the next launch after you quit DSH; redeploy after each DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 的可配置启动动画（splash）：主进程真实启动画面、设置页实时预览、深浅色跟随。通过改写 app.asar 部署（会保留备份），退出 DSH 后下次启动生效；DSH 升级后需重新部署。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot and annotation for the DSH composer, with a system-wide hotkey that captures without raising the DSH window. Windows only; on first use it compiles its helper executables from bundled C# source with the built-in csc.exe.
description.zh: 微信式截图标注，直接插进 DSH 输入框；系统级热键截图时不会把 DSH 弹到前台。仅支持 Windows；首次使用时用系统自带的 csc.exe 把随包的 C# 源码编译成辅助可执行文件。

description.en: Two-way bridge to a Server酱³ Bot (not SendKey push): messages sent in the app drive a DSH session, question and approval cards can be answered from the phone or the web, and agent plus scheduled output is pushed back to the chat. Pairing is trust-on-first-use: while the allow list (allowChatIds) is empty, the first chat that messages the bot is trusted, so set allowChatIds to pin it to your own chat.
description.zh: 与 Server酱³ Bot 的双向通道（不是 SendKey 单向推送）：在 App 里发消息即可驱动 DSH 会话，问题与批准卡片可在手机或网页任一端作答，Agent 与定时任务的输出再推回聊天。配对采用首次信任：allowChatIds 为空时，第一个给机器人发消息的聊天会被信任，请设置 allowChatIds 把它限定在你自己的聊天上。

description.en: Adopts DSH sessions created outside the running window (IDE/ACP clients, other processes) into their matching Workspace, and imports local sessions from other agent harnesses (pi) as native, resumable DSH sessions with sidebar sync/import actions and idempotent re-import.
description.zh: 把在运行窗口之外（IDE/ACP 客户端、其他进程）创建的 DSH 会话归入对应工作区，并把本机其他 Agent Harness（如 pi）的会话导入为可续聊的 DSH 原生会话，提供侧边栏同步/导入入口与幂等重复导入。

description.en: Tiered cold storage for DSH sessions: idle sessions move out of the live root into an on-disk cold tier instead of being deleted, an FTS5 index over that tier keeps them searchable, and a restore path moves a session back into the live root. Dry-run by default: nothing moves until you turn it off in Settings.
description.zh: DSH 会话的分层冷存储：闲置会话移出实时根目录、转入磁盘冷层而不被删除；冷层上的 FTS5 索引让它们仍可检索，需要时可将会话恢复回实时根目录。默认为演练模式，在设置页关闭后才会真正移动会话。

description.en: Shows the mode (agent preset) each Session runs under as a colored pill in the left sidebar, with a settings page for per-mode dot colors.
description.zh: 在左侧栏的会话行显示该会话运行的模式（agent preset）胶囊，并可在设置页按模式配置圆点颜色。

description.en: Fold the left sidebar panel entries into a More menu, freeing height for the workspace and session list; entries can be opened from the menu, restored in one click, and the choice persists across reloads. First install folds Taskboard, QQ Bot, Context Insights and SSH, and newly installed plugins fold by default (switchable).
description.zh: 把左侧栏的面板入口收进「更多」菜单，给下方工作区与会话列表腾出高度；入口可从菜单打开、一键全部还原，选择跨刷新保留。首次安装默认收起任务看板、QQ 机器人、上下文洞察与 SSH，之后新装的插件也默认收进「更多」（可关）。

description.en: Recent-first session sidebar with user groups, workspace tree, archive bucket, status dots and drag reorder.
description.zh: 最近优先的会话侧边栏：自定义分组、工作区树、归档、状态点与拖动排序。

description.en: Skill manager with content-addressed version history: snapshots, per-file and line-level diff, rollback, zip export and import, and per-skill enable or disable.
description.zh: 带内容寻址版本历史的技能管理器：快照、逐文件与行级差异、回滚、zip 导入导出、按技能停用或启用。

description.en: See the whole screen clearly: a 146-token overview map first, then 1:1 blocks up to 1400x900 so text is pixel-legible; a single sight_see tool with an on-screen eye toggle, measured against a 1600px host shrink limit. Windows only (it uses PowerShell); capture stays off until you click the eye.
description.zh: 一眼看清：先给一张 146 token 的整屏缩略地图，再按块 1:1 看清（单块上限 1400x900，字按原像素读），一个 sight_see 工具，界面上有一只眼睛随时开关；判据来自实测的 1600px 宿主缩图线。仅支持 Windows（依赖 PowerShell）；不点眼睛就不会截屏。

description.en: Multi-column tabbed workspace for the DSH main area: up to four sessions side by side, each with its own tab strip, composer and host view switcher. Cannot be enabled together with luckybilly's dsh-split-view; installs as the package dsh-multipane.
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区换成多栏标签工作区：最多四栏会话并排，每栏自带标签条、输入框和宿主视图切换条。不能与 luckybilly 的 dsh-split-view 同时启用；安装的包名是 dsh-multipane。

description.en: A cross-session project board for managing projects, plans, tasks, and external document references in the DSH web UI and agent tools. Verified on Windows 11 x64 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面和 agent 工具中跨会话管理项目、计划、任务和外置文档引用。仅在 Windows 11 x64 上验证过。

description.en: Restaurant store operations expert: reconcile a POS export, locate the gap, split volume vs price, measure discount efficiency, and open a single-file local-data dashboard.
description.zh: 餐饮门店经营分析专家：对账体检、找差距、量价拆解、算让利效率，并交付一个数据本地的单文件经营看板。

description.en: Design studio with MasterGo MCP node inspection, built-in implementation prompts and Reborn UI references. Needs the MasterGo desktop app with Vibe MCP enabled, and the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: 设计工作室，提供 MasterGo MCP 节点检查、内置实现提示词及 Reborn UI 参考。需本机 MasterGo 桌面端并开启 Vibe MCP，且先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Local fitness studio recording workouts, exercise duration and training volume within the DSH workspace, stored in the browser. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: DSH 工作区内的本机健身工作室，记录训练、运动时长与训练容量，数据存于浏览器本地存储。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Learning-plan tracker with local progress, notes and JSON progress backup. Ships one original six-node example roadmap; adding your own roadmaps means editing roadmaps.ts and rebuilding the plugin. Needs the dsh-studio-projects runtime and the dsh-worktable container from 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library installed first.
description.zh: 学习计划追踪：本机进度、笔记与 JSON 进度备份，附带一条原创六节点示例路线；添加自己的路线需编辑 roadmaps.ts 并重新构建插件。需先安装 1997liuyh-boop/dsh-studio-library 的 dsh-studio-projects 运行时与 dsh-worktable 容器。

description.en: Collapsible project drawer, split workspaces and session console for DSH studios, adapted from Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable under the same package name dsh-worktable, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 工作室的可折叠项目抽屉、分屏工作区与会话控制台，基于 Aisland-SJL/dsh-worktable 开发，包名同为 dsh-worktable，不能与上游同装。

description.en: One-shot OMP subagent provider for DeepSeek Harness — each delegation spawns the local `omp --print --mode json` CLI running with the user's own ~/.omp configuration and model bindings, and delegations are serialized so a single-session local engine is never oversubscribed. Requires the OMP (oh-my-pi) CLI installed locally and DSH 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一次性子代理提供器——每次委派都会启动本地 `omp --print --mode json` CLI，沿用用户自己的 ~/.omp 配置与模型绑定运行，且委派串行执行，单会话本地引擎不会被并发压垮。需本机已安装 OMP（oh-my-pi）CLI，并要求 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Adds a Settings page to pin one OpenAI-compatible subagent model (or follow the main model), writes the official subagent-model-selection allowlist, reminds the parent to pass that route, and optionally runs one-shot tasks through an isolated Pi CLI provider.
description.zh: 在设置里为子代理单独指定一个 OpenAI 兼容模型（或不选则跟随主模型），写入官方 subagent-model-selection 白名单，并在仅有一条路由时提醒主代理显式传参；可选提供与 DSH 进程隔离的 Pi CLI 一次性子代理。

description.en: Generates images in parallel with two configurable OpenAI Images-compatible or ComfyUI backends, compares the candidates, and optionally fuses them. Visual comparison needs a vision-capable model in DSH; without one the candidates are listed unscored.
description.zh: 通过两个独立配置的 OpenAI Images 兼容或 ComfyUI 后端并行生成图像，比较候选图并可选择融合。视觉比较需要 DSH 中有支持图像输入的模型；没有时候选图只列出、不打分。

description.en: Desktop-bundle fork of the DeepSeek Harness team's dsh-superagent research prototype: turns requests from allowed people on GitHub issues or Feishu into tickets worked by isolated DSH sessions, with a panel for sources, setup, prompts and run history. By default only people on a source's allowed list can start work. Needs git 2.32+ and the gh CLI for one GitHub repository; Feishu is optional and needs lark-cli.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 团队 dsh-superagent 研究原型的桌面 bundle 分支：把名单内的人在 GitHub issue 或飞书里提出的请求变成工单，交给相互隔离的 DSH 会话处理，面板里管理来源、部署、提示词与运行记录。默认只有来源名单里的人能发起工作。GitHub 来源需要 git 2.32+ 与 gh CLI；飞书可选，需要 lark-cli。

description.en: CPU, GPU and memory load in the DeepSeek Harness Session header: three compact cells with a percentage and a 2 px bar, coloured at 75 % and 90 %; CPU from os.cpus() deltas, GPU from nvidia-smi (Windows counter fallback).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话顶栏实时显示 CPU、GPU 与内存占用：三个小格各带百分比和 2 px 细条，75 %、90 % 变色；CPU 取 os.cpus() 差值，GPU 优先 nvidia-smi（Windows 下可退回性能计数器）。

description.en: Adds an index of every installable plugin tagged dsh-plugin on GitHub or npm to Plugins → Discover, rebuilt daily. On first run it also switches on the experimental Custom plugin index.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 和 npm 上所有打了 dsh-plugin 标签、可以安装的插件，作为索引源加入「插件 → 发现」，每天更新。首次运行时会同时打开实验性的「自定义插件索引」。

description.en: Tencent Agent Mail client: a sidebar panel for inbox and sent browsing, HTML reading in a sandboxed frame with remote images blocked by default, compose/reply/forward with attachments, search and permanent delete, adjustable font and surface opacity, plus five agent tools (mail_health, mail_list, mail_read, mail_search, mail_send) sending through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Needs a Tencent account (OAuth device-code login); the panel can install agently-cli for you. Tested on Windows only.
description.zh: 腾讯智能体邮箱（Agent Mail）客户端：侧边栏面板浏览收件箱与发件箱，HTML 正文在沙箱内渲染并默认拦截外链图片，支持写信、回复、转发、附件收发、搜索与永久删除，可调字体与界面透明度；另注册 5 个工具（mail_health、mail_list、mail_read、mail_search、mail_send），发信走已授权的 agently-cli 账号。需腾讯账号（设备码授权），面板可一键安装 agently-cli；仅在 Windows 上实测。

description.en: Highlights keywords and key sentences in DSH messages with the CSS Custom Highlight API (no DOM rewrite, survives streaming), and swaps the UI / message font in one click. Config lives in a small floating panel; code blocks and KaTeX are left alone.
description.zh: 用 CSS Highlight API 给 DSH 消息里的关键词和关键句上色（不重写 DOM，流式输出也不掉），再一键换掉界面/正文字体；配置在小浮窗里，代码块和公式不受影响。

description.en: Sidebar DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing hint with a Beijing-time countdown, Chinese public holidays and make-up workdays, daily pricing-rule refresh, official top-up offer status, and your account balance converted to input tokens (read with the DeepSeek platform sign-in already stored in DSH).
description.zh: 侧边栏 DeepSeek 峰谷计费提示，显示北京时间倒计时、中国法定节假日与调休、每日定价规则刷新、官方充值优惠状态，以及按当前时段折算成输入 tokens 的账户余额（使用 DSH 里已保存的 DeepSeek 平台登录凭据读取）。

description.en: Models 64-token cache blocks and calculates per-turn API costs and cache ROI.
description.zh: 建立 64 token 缓存块模型，计算每轮 API 花费及缓存投资回报率。

description.en: Model-classified tool compass for DeepSeek Harness: the agent sees functional categories and pulls specific tools on demand.
description.zh: 模型自动分类的工具罗盘：模型默认只看到功能类别，需要时检索并展开具体工具。

description.en: Usage and balance dock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: today's spend next to a Beijing-time peak/off-peak pricing band, today's tokens and cache hit rate, and a plain balance row that opens a detail panel. The panel lists the balance account, an eight-week activity heatmap where any day can be selected, and that day's tokens, cache hit rate, peak/off-peak cost and per-session breakdown with each session's own composition bar. Usage is read from the local session logs only; the only outbound request is the balance query against the provider base URL already configured in DSH. A heavily rewritten fork of Aisland-SJL/dsh-usage that uses the same plugin id (usage), so install only one of the two.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的用量与余额悬浮卡：今日花费配北京时间峰谷计价带、今日用量与缓存命中率，以及一行余额入口。面板里有余额账户明细、近八周活跃热力图（可点选任意一天），以及当天的用量、命中率、峰谷费用和按会话拆分的明细（每个会话带自己的成分条）。用量只读本机会话日志；唯一的对外请求是用 DSH 里已配置的供应商 base URL 查询余额。基于 Aisland-SJL/dsh-usage 大幅改写的分支，使用相同的插件 id（usage），两者只能安装其一。

description.en: Claim WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy CN / WorkBuddy global) daily check-in credits and benefit bonuses from a composer-dock card and an agent tool, using the official web OAuth login — no desktop client or third-party plugin needed. If another WorkBuddy plugin has already saved a login in ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault, it reuses that login instead of asking you to sign in again.
description.zh: 输入框工具行卡片与 agent 工具一键领取 WorkBuddy 每日签到积分与福利积分；走官方网页 OAuth 登录，无需桌面客户端或第三方插件。若本机其他 WorkBuddy 插件已在 ~/.dsh/workbuddy-vault 里保存了登录态，会直接复用，不再让你重新授权。

description.en: Adds per-workspace icons and a default session icon to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar. The workspace icon is picked inside the existing rename-workspace dialog; sessions without an IM channel get a default icon drawn with the same title pseudo-element the IM plugin uses, so the two stay aligned, while IM sessions keep their channel logo. Session rows are indented one level under their workspace with a vertical guide line. Icons come from 73 built-in Lucide glyphs, uploaded SVGs, or linked Iconify collections browsed from the official catalog, and follow the theme colors instead of a custom palette.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加逐工作区图标与默认会话图标。工作区图标在原有的「重命名工作区」弹窗里选取；没有 IM 渠道的会话显示默认图标，画法与 IM 插件同源的标题伪元素一致、两者对齐，已有渠道 logo 的会话保持原样。会话行相对工作区多缩进一级并带一条竖直引导线。图标来自 73 个内置 Lucide 图标、上传的 SVG，或从官方目录关联的 Iconify 图标库；配色跟随主题，不提供自定义调色。

description.en: Moves a workspace to another folder from its right-click menu: renames the folder, carries its nested workspaces and sessions along, rewrites their records, rolls back if anything fails, and can be undone in one click. Developed and verified on Windows first; macOS and Linux run the same code path.
description.zh: 在工作区右键菜单里把整个工作区搬到另一个目录，顺带重命名：嵌套工作区与会话一起迁移并改写记录，失败自动回滚，移动后可一键撤销。首先在 Windows 上开发与验证；macOS 与 Linux 走同一套代码路径。

description.en: QQ-bot console for DeepSeek Harness on Windows, with NapCat/AstrBot deployment, GPT-SoVITS integration, persona editing, local hybrid memory retrieval and a 3D memory graph. The services do not start automatically, and strangers get no tool access by default. QQ messages reach DSH through the third-party AstrBot (astrbot_plugin_dsh) and dsh-astrbot-ingress, both deployed from pinned sources.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人控制台，提供 NapCat/AstrBot 部署、GPT-SoVITS 对接、人格编辑、本地混合记忆检索和三维记忆图。服务不会自动启动，默认不向陌生人开放工具权限。QQ 消息经第三方 AstrBot（astrbot_plugin_dsh）与 dsh-astrbot-ingress 到达 DSH，二者均按固定版本的源码部署。

description.en: Runs the agent through GEML workflows: work items move through flow steps, practices are recorded at the step they belong to, and a board tab in the right sidebar shows where each item stands. Also mounts the GEML MCP server and skills; when the project has a fixed workflow, a supervisor gates tool calls by its current state. Needs Node.js 22+; the GEML MCP server is fetched with npx (@geml/geml) when a session starts.
description.zh: 用 GEML 流程带 agent 干活：工作项按流程一步步走，做法记在它所属的那一步，右侧栏的看板页签显示每件事走到哪了。同时挂上 GEML 的 MCP 服务和技能；项目里有固化流程时，监督器按流程当前状态把关工具调用。需要 Node.js 22+；GEML MCP 服务器在会话启动时经 npx（@geml/geml）获取。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools to discover MCP configurations across clients, audit static security rules and probe a named server, using a separately installed mcp-hub Rust binary.
description.zh: 通过单独安装的 mcp-hub Rust 程序，在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中跨客户端发现 MCP 配置、检查静态安全规则并验证指定服务的连通性。

description.en: Lightweight rule-based tools for street-level industry ecosystem work (party-building scenario): format enterprise profile cards, match supply and demand by category and quantity, normalize policy record fields (no raw-text parsing), and map grievance priority to an assignee role and estimated days. Calls no external systems.
description.zh: 面向党建引领街道产业生态场景的轻量规则工具：生成企业画像卡片、按品类与数量匹配供需、规整政策记录字段（不解析原文）、按优先级给出诉求处理人角色与预计天数；不调用任何外部系统。

description.en: Find Android game packages and guide Google Play dependency analysis and modification. Needs Python 3 and the Android tools you pick (JADX/apktool/adb).
description.zh: 查找 Android 游戏安装包，提供 Google Play 依赖分析与修改工作流。需要 Python 3 和你自选的 Android 工具（JADX/apktool/adb）。

description.en: Give it one URL and it traces the whole chain itself — DNS, reverse proxy, upstream, container, host and dependencies — then reports a root cause with evidence, so incident triage and routine operations run without anyone reciting where the machines or logs are. The chain comes from resource records it builds and keeps in your workspace; it is read-only by default and any change needs your explicit authorization.
description.zh: 给它一个 URL，它自己把整条链路查完——域名解析、反向代理、上游服务、容器、宿主机与依赖逐层核对，最后给出带证据的根因，让故障排查和日常运维不再依赖某个人记得机器和日志在哪。链路信息来自它在你的工作区里建立并维护的资源记录；默认只读，任何改动都需要你明确授权。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web panel for creating, evaluating, repairing, and installing skills, delegating generation to the official generic and Huawei Cloud skill creators. Needs git, bash and python3, and network access to gitcode.com (the creators and reference data are pulled from there); the creator runs shell commands with danger-full-access by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能创建面板：调用官方通用/华为云技能创建器生成技能，并提供评测、修复、安装与创建记录。需要 git、bash 与 python3，并能访问 gitcode.com（创建器与参考数据从那里拉取）；创建器默认以 danger-full-access 权限执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Helps students and programming beginners learn technical English while working on projects. Chinese replies introduce English technical terms with Chinese definitions on first mention, then reuse the English names within the same reply. Supports Codex; the DSH integration requires macOS with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 or 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 帮助学生和编程初学者边做项目，边学习专业英语。中文回答首次标注英文术语及中文释义，同条后续沿用英文名称。支持 Codex；DSH 接入要求 macOS，宿主版本为 0.2.1-rc.3 或 0.2.2-rc.1。
